Figueiredo -> Nima: WP23a topology-general classification + CP-triviality rule
operations.body: WP23a (ledger 1951): the a1 classification is not a viable-ensemble artifact. All 6552 full-rank one-cycle nine-link topologies verified: 5904 fall into the four WP22 classes with zero anomalies; the other 648 have detC identically zero (J=0 by support alone) with an exact iff: diagonal decomposed sector + >=1 disjoint connected-sector row pair, or block21 + >=2. All CP-trivial cases are 4-cycles. Certificate: results/wp23_topology_enumeration.json (commit bab761b2). The support theorem of 1054 now has its full companion classification on the same domain.

operations.body: WP23a (ledger 1951): four-class a1 classification extends from the 755 viable textures to all 6552 full-rank one-cycle topologies, zero exceptions. New: 648 topologies (9.9%) are CP-trivial by support (detC identically 0), characterized exactly by connected-sector row-overlap disjointness (diag: >=1 disjoint pair; block21: >=2). The viable ensemble avoids the trivial locus entirely. Chart typing unchanged: all factors chart data.
